title: Evaluation of a constant gate
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs, let $x$ be an input, and let $i$ be a gate. If gate $i$ is the constant Boolean value $b$, then its value on $x$ is $b$.
hypotheses_covered: Gate i is the constant b
